subject: Cognitive Science
title: Pragmatics: Reading Between the Lines
description: A micro-lesson that makes Pragmatics: Reading Between the Lines usable.

hook.text: Someone asks 'Can you pass the salt?' You don't say 'Yes, I can' and sit still. You pass the salt.

buildup.text: Pragmatics is the study of meaning beyond literal words—the intentions, context, and social rules behind speech.

discovery.text: Paul Grice identified maxims of conversation: be relevant, be brief, be truthful, and be clear.

twist.text: We constantly violate these maxims on purpose. Sarcasm, irony, and politeness all work by breaking the rules.

climax.text: An AI that only understands literal meaning would fail at human conversation within seconds.

punchline.text: Most of what we mean is never actually said.

details.summary: Pragmatics studies how context shapes meaning beyond literal words. Saying it is cold in here can be a request to close the window. Grice's maxims of conversation explain how speakers cooperate: be informative, truthful, relevant, and clear.
details.whyItMatters: Most communication relies on inference, not literal meaning. Pragmatics explains sarcasm, politeness, metaphor, and why AI chatbots often miss the point.
takeaways: Meaning goes far beyond the literal words spoken
Grice's cooperative principle guides conversational inference
Implicatures are unstated meanings derived from context

faq.question: What are Grice's maxims of conversation?
faq.answer: Quantity: be as informative as required. Quality: say only what you believe true. Relation: be relevant. Manner: be clear and orderly. Speakers follow these by default. When a maxim is ostentatiously violated, listeners infer a deeper intended meaning, called a conversational implicature.

faq.question: How do children learn to understand pragmatics?
faq.answer: Pragmatic understanding develops gradually. Young children tend to interpret language literally and struggle with sarcasm, indirect requests, and irony. Theory of mind, understanding that others have different knowledge and intentions, is a prerequisite.
